embed_video_watermark: embed a watermark into a video file and save the watermarked output to a directory
embed_audio_watermark: embed a watermark into the audio track of a video file alongside the video watermark
detect_video_watermark: detect and extract a watermark message from a watermarked video file
detect_audio_watermark: detect and extract a watermark message from the audio track of a watermarked video
run_inference_av: run video and audio watermarking inference with argparse CLI on an input mp4 file
